combo_label: The Pub × Bridges × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Iron with a little carbon in it, the Bessemer converter's great product
Harbour city where a vast grey curve is nicknamed the Coathanger
Yellow Hargreaves chap shaped like a rubber ball; to spring back off the floor
Hargreaves' vast pink fellow who eats the lot and eyes up your plate too
Bristle circle of twenty numbered beds, ringed for doubles and trebles
Hargreaves who invented this cast of coloured shapes back in 1971
Dublin-brewed black beer, its label marked with a golden harp
Bar that takes a squeeze rather than a pull; also a cocky walk
Malt goes in, hops go in, and beer runs out of the works
Little Miss who stomps flat on Mr Uppity's hat for the fun of it; badly behaved
